status: Written before computing window statistics; retrospective exploratory analysis of previously inspected recordings
primary: Complete non-overlapping windows anchored at the first sample of each original scored interval. Incomplete trailing windows excluded and duration reported. Original settling samples retained.
boundary_handling: Integrate piecewise-linear interpolation by trapezoids with explicit interpolated endpoints; no refitting, clipping, or added smoothing.
aggregation: Mean window error within each motion, then unweighted mean of nine motion means. Windows are not independent trials.
sensitivity: All complete windows starting at each recorded 0.1 s sample; same motion-balanced averaging. Descriptive only, no confidence intervals or p-values.
validation: Reproduce published full-trial energies/errors and independently compare per-window quadrature with cumulative piecewise-linear integrals.
